craft_notes: Sthāyin: cakrodaya unit 12. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Fourteen hundreds sky-ocean would be in fifteen-syllable; thirteen hundreds with half in sixteen-syllable but is said.
l4.sanskrit_cite: caturdaśaśatī khābdhiḥ syātpañcadaśavarṇake trayodaśaśatī sārdhā ṣoḍaśārṇe tu kathyate
